desc: 一按成雾缓按成线，倒喷两用控油不挂壁，玻璃瓶身可视余量
name: 二合一玻璃喷油不滴漏款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里用一支干净立正的二合一喷油壶一眼抓住点击，承担合规主图位。
一秒讲清按压出雾与缓按出线两种用法，把主利益直接铺在暗底上。
shots.textZone: 顶部 30% 一行主标题位，只放「{selling_point_1}」

shots.intent: 用左右双栏同框近摄加勾叉位的结构，替买家做完选择这一步。
shots.textZone: 每栏下方一枚短标签位，左读「{callout_1}」右读「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 把产品放进真实清晨厨房台面，让买家代入自己拌沙拉的那一刻。
微距证明结构与做工，把按压件与凸出短嘴一次看清，解释它为什么不挂壁。
展示灶台煎炒时慢按成细线淋油的第二种用法，覆盖热烹饪场景。
深浅两色并列加空白标注线，让买家一次选色并对上大致身形。
shots.textZone: 标注线端头三枚空白短标签位，读「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 收口在真实家庭餐桌上，用日常高频感消除买不买值的最后疑虑。

style.backgroundSystem: three rotating fields only: seamless studio white #FFFFFF for packshots, sunlit cream-and-oak counter #F4EDE1 over warm oak #B9814E for lifestyle, deep charcoal graphic field #23211E with one amber accent #D9A02B for mechanism and spec screens
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons, empty round tick and cross slots, blank dimension lines with bracket end caps, all in one accent colour #D9A02B
style.lightingSystem: soft front-left key with bounce fill, true contact shadows, one controlled specular through glass; warm lifestyle light around 4000K from a window side; skimming side light reserved for macro detail; never flat and never clinical
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm kitchen oil-control ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio white #FFFFFF, warm cream #F4EDE1, warm oak #B9814E, deep charcoal #23211E and one amber accent #D9A02B; warm temperature held across every frame; backgrounds rotate between a clean studio field, a sunlit oak counter and a deep charcoal graphic field; lighting system is a soft front-left key with bounce fill, true contact shadows and one controlled specular through glass, with skimming side light only for macro detail; surfaces are warm oak #B9814E, worn wooden board and pale stone #F7F2E9; modern geometric sans-serif reserved for post-production callout slots; thin single-weight line icons with empty tick and cross slots and blank dimension lines; product presented as one stable upright family with a consistent tilt language for mist and pour and a matte rather than glossy cap; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no readable scale numerals, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no mixed fonts and no readable scale numerals inside the frame
no random backgrounds and no cluttered kitchen props
no inconsistent lighting direction between paired or split panels
no glossy cap rendering and no invented mechanism parts
style.presentationRules: one product family throughout: upright body on white, slight downward tilt when misting, steeper tilt when pouring, cap always reading matte rather than glossy, scale stable across the set
style.surfaceSystem: warm oak counter #B9814E, worn wooden board, pale stone tabletop #F7F2E9, matte porcelain stovetop #E4DBCB
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, applied only in post-production callout slots; one headline line plus at most two short labels, no dense body copy
